cases.candidate_script:
[[ $(type -t git) == builtin ]] || exit 99
set -e
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture
export GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-01-01T00:00:00+0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-01-01T00:00:00+0000'
/usr/bin/git init -q --bare remote
/usr/bin/git init -q -b main seed
printf 'base\n' >seed/file
/usr/bin/git -C seed add file
/usr/bin/git -C seed commit -qm base
/usr/bin/git -C seed push -q ../remote main
/usr/bin/git clone -q -b main remote topic
printf 'remote\n' >>seed/file
/usr/bin/git -C seed commit -qam remote
/usr/bin/git -C seed push -q ../remote main
printf 'local\n' >>topic/file
/usr/bin/git -C topic commit -qam local
before=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
for value in unset 0 00 000 false no off 1 true yes on; do
  if [[ $value == unset ]]; then unset GIT_ADVICE; else export GIT_ADVICE=$value; fi
  status=0
  git -C topic push ../remote main >"$HOME/push-$value.stdout" 2>"$HOME/push-$value.stderr" || status=$?
  [[ $status != 0 ]] || exit 90
  hint=no
  if /usr/bin/grep -q '^hint:' "$HOME/push-$value.stderr"; then hint=yes; fi
  after=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
  [[ $before == "$after" ]] || exit 91
  printf '%s rejected=yes hint=%s remote=unchanged\n' "$value" "$hint"
done
/usr/bin/rm -rf remote seed topic

cases.comparison: Quiet successful push is silent, and quiet rejected push reports remote rejection, fails, and preserves the server ref.
cases.oracle: System Git creates and updates a fixture-only bare repository, then a pre-receive hook refuses a later update; compare with Git 2.47.3 client.
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z'
git -C local push -q ../remote main >"$HOME/quiet-success.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-success.err"; rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.out && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.err ]]; then echo 'quiet-success=yes'; else echo 'quiet-success=no'; fi
before=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
printf 'second\n' >>local/file
/usr/bin/git -C local commit -qam second
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho rejected-by-hook >&2\nexit 1\n' >remote/hooks/pre-receive
/usr/bin/chmod 755 remote/hooks/pre-receive
git -C local push -q ../remote main >"$HOME/quiet-rejected.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-rejected.err"; rc=$?
after=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
if [[ $rc == 1 && $after == "$before" ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'remote rejected' "$HOME/quiet-rejected.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'quiet-rejection=yes'; else echo 'quiet-rejection=no'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf remote local

cases.comparison: Accept the matching git namespace and bare key; reject unrelated namespace and future validity without ignoring restrictions.
cases.oracle: System Git 2.47.3 and OpenSSH validate a system-signed commit using a fixture-generated ED25519 key and explicit allowed-signers restrictions.
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
for mode in bare git other future; do
  git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/signers-$mode" verify-commit HEAD >"$HOME/verify-$mode.out" 2>"$HOME/verify-$mode.err"; rc=$?
  good=no; if [[ $rc == 0 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/verify-$mode.err" >/dev/null; then good=yes; fi
  printf '%s verified=%s\n' "$mode" "$good"
done
/usr/bin/rm -rf signed

printf 'fixture@example.test namespaces="other" %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/signers-other"
printf 'fixture@example.test namespaces="git",valid-after="29990101Z" %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/signers-future"
/usr/bin/git init -q -b main signed
printf 'signed\n' >signed/file
/usr/bin/git -C signed add file

cases.comparison: Both clients must create an SSH-signed commit, and system Git must verify the new commit against the namespace-restricted allowed signer. The independent system verification pins its ssh-keygen executable to the prepared image path.
cases.oracle: Fixture-generated key and independently invoked system Git/OpenSSH verify the actual newly created commit signature.
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z'
printf 'candidate\n' >>signed/file
/usr/bin/git -C signed add file
git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c user.signingKey="$HOME/key" commit -q -S -m candidate >"$HOME/sign.out" 2>"$HOME/sign.err"; rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 0 ]]; then echo 'sign=yes'; else echo 'sign=no'; fi
/usr/bin/git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.program=/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/signers-git" verify-commit HEAD >"$HOME/system-verify.out" 2>"$HOME/system-verify.err"; verified=$?
if [[ $rc == 0 && $verified == 0 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'Good "git" signature for fixture@example.test' "$HOME/system-verify.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'system-verifies=yes'; else echo 'system-verifies=no'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf signed

cases.comparison: Compare quiet success and remote-hook rejection via fake SSH and independent system git-receive-pack; preserve separate original local-path case.
cases.oracle: System Git over fixture-only fake SSH against independent system git-receive-pack and pre-receive hook; no external network.
cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z'
GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/tmp/parity-case/fakessh-quiet git -C local push -q ssh://fixture/tmp/parity-case/remote main >"$HOME/quiet-success.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-success.err"; rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 0 && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.out && ! -s $HOME/quiet-success.err ]]; then echo 'quiet-success=yes'; else echo 'quiet-success=no'; fi
before=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
printf 'second\n' >>local/file
/usr/bin/git -C local commit -qam second
printf '#!/bin/sh\n/usr/bin/touch "$HOME/quiet-hook-ran"\necho rejected-by-hook >&2\nexit 1\n' >remote/hooks/pre-receive
/usr/bin/chmod 755 remote/hooks/pre-receive
GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/tmp/parity-case/fakessh-quiet git -C local push -q ssh://fixture/tmp/parity-case/remote main >"$HOME/quiet-rejected.out" 2>"$HOME/quiet-rejected.err"; rc=$?
after=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse refs/heads/main)
if [[ $rc == 1 && $after == "$before" ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'remote rejected' "$HOME/quiet-rejected.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'quiet-rejection=yes'; else echo 'quiet-rejection=no'; fi
if [[ -e $HOME/quiet-hook-ran ]]; then echo 'hook-ran=yes'; else echo 'hook-ran=no'; fi
printf 'rejection-rc=%s\n' "$rc"
if [[ $after == "$before" ]]; then echo 'remote-unchanged=yes'; else echo 'remote-unchanged=no'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf remote local /tmp/parity-case/fakessh-quiet
cases.setup_script:
export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=gc.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=0 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=maintenance.auto GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=false

cat > /tmp/parity-case/fakessh-quiet <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
while [ $# -gt 2 ]; do case $1 in -o|-p) shift 2;; *) shift;; esac; done

EOF
/usr/bin/chmod 755 /tmp/parity-case/fakessh-quiet
